# Social My Business

> The Social My Business Accelerator is a paid advertising and consulting program for local businesses in the United States. It includes a 30-minute lead generation consultation on ad optimization, year-round campaign support, and approved sponsored advertiser status inside private buy/sell/trade communities with more than 200,000 combined members. Pricing is $75 per month for the first group and $25 per month for each additional group, with a twelve-month commitment. Sign-up is by phone at 1-800-481-8638.

Operated by Eye To Ad Media (Search Converts LLC), 1001 Bannock St #660, Denver, CO 80204.
Contact: 1-800-481-8638 · info@eyetoad.com · https://eyetoad.com

## Key facts

- Program name: The Social My Business Accelerator
- First group: $75 per month (standard rate $150, currently half price)
- Each additional group: $25 per month
- Event promotion: $100 per event, no commitment
- Commitment: 12 months for ongoing sponsorship
- Combined community membership: 200,000+
- Availability: United States, nationwide
- Sign-up: by phone only, approximately 10 minutes
- Sponsorship fees are waived entirely for Eye To Ad Media SEO clients ($0)
- Results are not guaranteed; the program guarantees access, consultation, placements and support

## What is included

- 30-minute one-on-one lead generation consultation on ad structure, reach and conversion
- Year-round strategy access for campaign feedback at no additional cost
- Unlimited posting, with no stacked posts and no spam
- Featured placements throughout the year, plus two complimentary featured posts at sign-up
- Capped competition: advertisers are limited per industry per group; some categories are fully exclusive
- Admin protection against spammers and trolls
- All communities are private; posts are visible to members only

## How it works

1. Call 1-800-481-8638 with your business, city and what you sell.
2. Category availability is checked for your market; exclusivity is discussed if open.
3. Complete the 30-minute consultation on ad optimization.
4. Get approved as a sponsored advertiser; two complimentary featured posts are applied.
5. Use year-round support for campaign feedback and admin help.

## Who it fits

Local service businesses and local retailers whose customers live within driving distance: plumbing, HVAC, roofing, electrical, painting, landscaping, tree service, concrete and asphalt, handyman, remodeling, flooring and tile, cleaning, junk removal, moving, pest control, auto repair, auto glass, detailing, towing, real estate, property management, insurance, salons and barbers, med spas, dental and orthodontic, chiropractic, fitness, restaurants, catering, food trucks, photography, event promoters, childcare, pet services, retail and resale, storage, solar, security systems.

Not a fit for international customers or enterprise B2B sales with long procurement cycles.
